name: GKE Binary Authorization Break-Glass
description: Binary Authorization is a check that only signed, approved images may run on GKE. Break-glass is the emergency bypass. An attacker who can deploy with break-glass runs unsigned images — miners, backdoors, anything — while the policy still looks enabled in the console. Legitimate break-glass is rare and should page the platform team. Unsigned deploys with the break-glass flag from a non-emergency identity are the incident.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
